description.en:
Basic Attack

Perform up to 3 consecutive attacks of Holy Light, dealing Spectro DMG.

Heavy Attack

Consume STA to attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG.

Mid-air Attack

Consume STA to ride the staff and dive down from mid-air to attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG.

Mid-air Heavy Attack

Consume STA to ride on the staff for a distance.
- Can be re-cast after a Mid-Air Dodge or using Grapple.

Dodge Counter

After a successful Dodge, quickly use Basic Attack to attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG.
- When Phoebe is inside the Ring of Mirrors, Dodge Counter becomes Chamuel's Star: Dodge Counter.
description.id:
Basic Attack

Melakukan hingga 3 serangan beruntun Holy Light yang memberikan Spectro DMG.

Heavy Attack

Mengonsumsi STA untuk menyerang target, memberikan Spectro DMG.

Mid-air Attack

Mengonsumsi STA untuk menunggangi tongkat dan menukik dari udara untuk menyerang target, memberikan Spectro DMG.

Mid-air Heavy Attack

Mengonsumsi STA untuk menunggangi tongkat sejauh jarak tertentu.
- Dapat dilancarkan ulang setelah Mid-Air Dodge atau menggunakan Grapple.

Dodge Counter

Setelah Dodge berhasil, segera gunakan Basic Attack untuk menyerang target, memberikan Spectro DMG.
- Saat Phoebe berada di dalam Ring of Mirrors, Dodge Counter menjadi Chamuel's Star: Dodge Counter.

description.en:
Summon a Ring of Mirrors at the target location, making the target hit stagnate for 2s and dealing Spectro DMG. The stagnation effect can be applied to 12 targets max for each Ring of Mirrors. Using Resonance Skill again shortly after the summoning teleports Phoebe to the Ring of Mirrors' location, dealing Spectro DMG.
Unable to teleport if Phoebe is too far from the Ring of Mirrors.

Ring of Mirrors

- Ring of Mirrors lasts for 30s. When Phoebe summons a new Ring of Mirrors, the existing Ring of Mirrors disappears.
- When Phoebe is outside of the Ring of Mirrors, a Basic Attack or Dodge Counter that hits the Ring of Mirrors will refract Holy Light, which deals Spectro DMG to targets inside the Ring of Mirrors and pulls the targets hit to the center of the ring. The DMG dealt is considered Basic Attack DMG. Can be triggered once every 0.5s.
- When Phoebe is inside the Ring of Mirrors, Basic Attack becomes Basic Attack Chamuel's Star, which performs up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing Spectro DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG.
description.id:
Memanggil Ring of Mirrors di lokasi target, membuat target yang terkena mengalami Stagnation selama 2 dtk dan memberikan Spectro DMG. Efek Stagnation dapat diterapkan pada maksimal 12 target untuk setiap Ring of Mirrors. Menggunakan Resonance Skill lagi sesaat setelah pemanggilan akan memindahkan Phoebe ke lokasi Ring of Mirrors, memberikan Spectro DMG.
Tidak dapat berpindah jika Phoebe terlalu jauh dari Ring of Mirrors.

Ring of Mirrors

- Ring of Mirrors bertahan selama 30 dtk. Saat Phoebe memanggil Ring of Mirrors baru, Ring of Mirrors yang ada akan menghilang.
- Saat Phoebe berada di luar Ring of Mirrors, Basic Attack atau Dodge Counter yang mengenai Ring of Mirrors akan membiaskan Holy Light, yang memberikan Spectro DMG kepada target di dalam Ring of Mirrors dan menarik target yang terkena ke pusat ring. DMG yang diberikan dianggap sebagai Basic Attack DMG. Dapat aktif sekali setiap 0,5 dtk.
- Saat Phoebe berada di dalam Ring of Mirrors, Basic Attack menjadi Basic Attack Chamuel's Star, yang melakukan hingga 3 serangan beruntun yang memberikan Spectro DMG, dianggap sebagai Basic Attack DMG.

attributes.name: Ring of Mirrors: Refracted Holy Light DMG

description.en:
Phoebe concentrates the light in her hands into the Mirror of Enlightenment and smashes it, dealing Spectro DMG.
- Absolution Enhancement: Increase DMG Multiplier by 255%.
- Confession Enhancement: Apply 8 stacks of Spectro Frazzle to targets hit.
description.id:
Phoebe memusatkan cahaya di tangannya menjadi Mirror of Enlightenment lalu menghantamkannya, memberikan Spectro DMG.
- Absolution Enhancement: Meningkatkan pengali DMG sebesar 255%.
- Confession Enhancement: Menerapkan 8 stack Spectro Frazzle pada target yang terkena.

description.en: Mid-air Heavy Attack can be cast 1 more times.
description.id: Mid-air Heavy Attack dapat dilancarkan 1 kali lagi.

description.en: When in the Absolution status and Confession status, Spectro DMG Bonus is increased by 12%.
description.id: Saat dalam status Absolution dan status Confession, Spectro DMG Bonus meningkat sebesar 12%.

description.en: Knock back nearby targets and deal Spectro DMG.
description.id: Menghempaskan target di sekitar dan memberikan Spectro DMG.

description.en:
When Phoebe's Prayer is full, consume all Prayer to cast one of the following skills:
- Hold Basic Attack to cast Heavy Attack Absolution Litany, dealing Spectro DMG and applying 1 stack of Spectro Frazzle to the targets hit. Phoebe enters Absolution status, which allows her to deal more damage.
- Hold Resonance Skill to cast Resonance Skill Utter Confession, dealing Spectro DMG and applying 1 stack of Spectro Frazzle to the targets hit. Phoebe enters Confession status, which allows her to better exploit Spectro Frazzle.
- Absolution and Confession cannot coexist. Entering into one will end the other.
- When Divine Voice is not exhausted, Phoebe is unable to cast Heavy Attack Absolution Litany and Resonance Skill Utter Confession.
- When Divine Voice is exhausted, Phoebe will not exit the Absolution or Confession status.

Heavy Attack: Starflash

When Phoebe has Divine Voice, casting Basic Attack Stage 3 or Dodge Counter replaces the next Heavy Attack with Heavy Attack: Starflash, which deals Spectro DMG at the cost of 30 Divine Voice.
- Absolution Enhancement: Reduce the cost of Divine Voice by 15. When the targets hit have Spectro Frazzle, the skill gains 256% DMG Amplification.
- Confession Enhancement: Apply 5 stacks of Spectro Frazzle to the targets hit.

Prayer

Phoebe can hold up to 120 Prayer.
Phoebe automatically gains 5 Prayer every second.

Divine Voice

Phoebe can hold up to 60 Divine Voice.
Casting Heavy Attack Absolution Litany or Resonance Skill Utter Confession restores 60 Divine Voice.
description.id:
Saat Prayer Phoebe penuh, konsumsi seluruh Prayer untuk melancarkan salah satu skill berikut:
- Tahan Basic Attack untuk melancarkan Heavy Attack Absolution Litany, memberikan Spectro DMG dan menerapkan 1 stack Spectro Frazzle pada target yang terkena. Phoebe memasuki status Absolution, yang memungkinkannya memberikan lebih banyak damage.
- Tahan Resonance Skill untuk melancarkan Resonance Skill Utter Confession, memberikan Spectro DMG dan menerapkan 1 stack Spectro Frazzle pada target yang terkena. Phoebe memasuki status Confession, yang memungkinkannya memanfaatkan Spectro Frazzle dengan lebih baik.
- Absolution dan Confession tidak dapat aktif bersamaan. Memasuki salah satunya akan mengakhiri yang lain.
- Saat Divine Voice belum habis, Phoebe tidak dapat melancarkan Heavy Attack Absolution Litany dan Resonance Skill Utter Confession.
- Saat Divine Voice habis, Phoebe tidak akan keluar dari status Absolution atau Confession.

Heavy Attack: Starflash

Saat Phoebe memiliki Divine Voice, melancarkan Basic Attack Tahap 3 atau Dodge Counter akan menggantikan Heavy Attack berikutnya dengan Heavy Attack: Starflash, yang memberikan Spectro DMG dengan biaya 30 Divine Voice.
- Absolution Enhancement: Mengurangi biaya Divine Voice sebesar 15. Saat target yang terkena memiliki Spectro Frazzle, skill mendapat 256% DMG Amplify.
- Confession Enhancement: Menerapkan 5 stack Spectro Frazzle pada target yang terkena.

Prayer

Phoebe dapat menyimpan hingga 120 Prayer.
Phoebe otomatis mendapat 5 Prayer setiap detik.

Divine Voice

Phoebe dapat menyimpan hingga 60 Divine Voice.
Melancarkan Heavy Attack Absolution Litany atau Resonance Skill Utter Confession memulihkan 60 Divine Voice.

description.en: Has a chance to produce special dishes when cooking.
description.id: Berpeluang menghasilkan hidangan spesial saat memasak.

description.en:
Deal Spectro DMG equal to 528.41% of Phoebe's ATK to nearby targets.
- Absolution Enhancement: Increase DMG Multiplier by 255%.
- Confession Enhancement: Grant Silent Prayer to the Resonator on the field, reducing the Spectro RES of nearby targets by 10% and granting 100% Spectro Frazzle DMG Amplification. When Spectro Frazzle inflicts DMG, extend Spectro Frazzle's damage interval by 50%. This effect lasts 30s or until Phoebe switches to Absolution status.
description.id:
Memberikan Spectro DMG sebesar 528,41% ATK Phoebe kepada target di sekitar.
- Absolution Enhancement: Meningkatkan pengali DMG sebesar 255%.
- Confession Enhancement: Memberikan Silent Prayer kepada Resonator di lapangan, mengurangi Spectro RES target di sekitar sebesar 10% dan memberikan 100% Spectro Frazzle DMG Amplify. Saat Spectro Frazzle memberikan DMG, interval damage Spectro Frazzle diperpanjang sebesar 50%. Efek ini bertahan selama 30 dtk atau hingga Phoebe beralih ke status Absolution.

description.en: When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, the Resonator may cast Tune Break on the target.
description.id: Saat Off-Tune Level target penuh, Resonator dapat melancarkan Tune Break pada target.

description.en:
When in Absolution, Resonance Liberation Dawn of Enlightenment now increases DMG Multiplier by 480% instead of 255%.
When in Confession, Resonance Liberation Dawn of Enlightenment increases DMG Multiplier by 90% and applies Spectro Frazzle to the targets with the maximum stack the targets can receive.
description.id:
Saat dalam Absolution, Resonance Liberation Dawn of Enlightenment kini meningkatkan pengali DMG sebesar 480% alih-alih 255%.
Saat dalam Confession, Resonance Liberation Dawn of Enlightenment meningkatkan pengali DMG sebesar 90% dan menerapkan Spectro Frazzle pada target dengan stack maksimum yang dapat diterima target.

description.en:
When in Absolution, DMG dealt by Outro Skills to targets with Spectro Frazzle is Amplified by 120%.
When in Confession, Silent Prayer grants 120% more DMG Amplification for Spectro Frazzle.
description.id:
Saat dalam Absolution, DMG yang diberikan Outro Skill kepada target dengan Spectro Frazzle di-Amplify sebesar 120%.
Saat dalam Confession, Silent Prayer memberikan tambahan 120% DMG Amplify untuk Spectro Frazzle.

description.en:
When in Absolution, the DMG Multiplier of Heavy Attack Starflash is increased by 91%.
When in Confession, the DMG Multiplier of Heavy Attack Starflash is increased by 249%.
description.id:
Saat dalam Absolution, pengali DMG Heavy Attack Starflash meningkat sebesar 91%.
Saat dalam Confession, pengali DMG Heavy Attack Starflash meningkat sebesar 249%.

description.en: When Basic Attack, Basic Attack Chamuel's Star, Dodge Counter, or Chamuel's Star: Dodge Counter hits, the target's Spectro RES is reduced by 10% for 30s.
description.id: Saat Basic Attack, Basic Attack Chamuel's Star, Dodge Counter, atau Chamuel's Star: Dodge Counter mengenai target, Spectro RES target berkurang sebesar 10% selama 30 dtk.

description.en: Casting Intro Skill Golden Grace increases Phoebe's Spectro DMG Bonus by 12% for 15s.
description.id: Melancarkan Intro Skill Golden Grace meningkatkan Spectro DMG Bonus Phoebe sebesar 12% selama 15 dtk.

description.en:
Targets entering the Ring of Mirrors are stagnated for an additional 2s. The stagnation effect affects all targets entering the Ring of Mirrors and can be applied to 12 targets max for each Ring of Mirrors. Each target will only be affected by this effect once.
When in Absolution or Confession, summoning a Ring of Mirrors with Resonance Skill increases Phoebe's ATK by 10% for 20s, and triggers an extra Heavy Attack Starflash at the Ring of Mirrors' location. This Heavy Attack Starflash does not consume Divine Voice and is not considered as casting a Heavy Attack.
description.id:
Target yang memasuki Ring of Mirrors mengalami Stagnation tambahan selama 2 dtk. Efek Stagnation memengaruhi semua target yang memasuki Ring of Mirrors dan dapat diterapkan pada maksimal 12 target untuk setiap Ring of Mirrors. Setiap target hanya akan terkena efek ini sekali.
Saat dalam Absolution atau Confession, memanggil Ring of Mirrors dengan Resonance Skill meningkatkan ATK Phoebe sebesar 10% selama 20 dtk, dan memicu satu Heavy Attack Starflash tambahan di lokasi Ring of Mirrors. Heavy Attack Starflash ini tidak mengonsumsi Divine Voice dan tidak dianggap sebagai melancarkan Heavy Attack.
